chunks: About a muhrim squeezing a boil and tying a cloth over it, he said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.الْخِرْقَةَ: a cloth or bandage tied over something
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a muhrim in ihram to squeeze a boil and tie a cloth over it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim during ihram. It states that squeezing a boil and tying a cloth over it is permissible and carries no harm or prohibition in this state.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2655 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar asked Imam (as) about a Muhrim squeezing a boil and tying a cloth around it.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
